Description:
The hotel is located at the scenic Grand Canyon West in Northern Arizona, less than a 3-hour drive from Las Vegas.

The ranch offers visitors western hospitality, cowboy entertainment, wagon rides, horseback rides and canyon-facing cabins. While staying overnight, the cowboys tell stories around an open fire and make delicious S'mores (a traditional American camping snack consisting of biscuits, chocolate and toasted marshmallows). Visitors can learn how to rope, quick draw and tomahawk toss the cowboy way. Guests may watch the sunrise over the Grand Canyon with a blanket and a cup of coffee, a unique and memorable experience. There are 26 guest rooms at this themed hotel. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services. Facilities include a cloakroom, café, restaurant and a car park.

This ranch offers western themed cabins with rustic cowboy furniture facing the Grand Canyon Rim. There are single, double and family rooms with some adjoining cabins. Each cabin is equipped with a private en suite bathroom, shower and climate control. Each room also has a double bed, individually regulated heating, individually regulated air conditioning and a terrace. Wake up calls to watch the sunrise over the canyon are done by cowboys knocking on the door.

Guests can take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool. Recreational activities on offer also include motor boating, horse riding and entertainment programmes for both adults and children.

Description:
Featuring Wild West themed accommodations, these uniquely decorated Boutique Cabins are located in historic Williams, AZ, the Gateway to the Grand Canyon! Trappers Rendezvous is your perfect spot to relax during your trip, just about a mile from the bustling center of this Route 66 town with a view of the mountains. Sit in your porch chairs with a drink in hand to watch the sunset, or let the kids get their travel wiggles out running around outside in the warm months!

Breakfast is offered as an optional addition to your stay, with options from a To-Go bag packed to start your early morning adventures, to a light breakfast basket with homemade muffins and other delights to be enjoyed in your room, outdoor pavilion or guest den! Breakfast must be booked with the innkeeper at least 24 hours prior to your stay.

Each room offers a private porch entrance, and convenient parking just a few steps from your door. All rooms have their own private en suite bathroom with tub/shower, with cozy bathrobes, extra towels, and a hairdryer provided, along with boutique body care products. Relax in the unique comfy seating space of your room, or put your feet up in bed and watch a movie on your flat-screen satellite TV. Our two suite rooms offer a second TV in the second room as well.

All rooms have their own mini fridge, coffee maker, and microwave, and our reception area is stocked with snacks and beverages that you are welcome to grab when you check in, or come in to visit guest den during your stay. All guests are welcome to use the propane grill under the central communal pavilion area. Trappers also offers one Family Suite that adds a kitchenette complete with full size refrigerator, dishes, sink, toaster, electric skillet, crock pot, microwave steamer, and private back porch to enjoy your meal as a family.

Our fire pit is available for guests to use on their own, when fire restrictions are not in place. Trappers provides kindling and logs, fire starter and lighters, and even marshmallow sticks!

The Grand Canyon South Rim is just about an hour drive through beautiful high desert. Drive yourself, or book a train ride on the Grand Canyon Railway!

Closer to home, take advantage of the miles and miles of hiking trails and lakes surrounding us in Kaibab National Forest, hit the links at Elephant Rocks Golf Course, have a wildlife adventure at Bearizona, or enjoy exciting day-trips to Flagstaff, Sedona, Prescott, or historic Jerome.

Description:
Featuring Wild West themed accommodations, these uniquely decorated Boutique Cabins are located in historic Williams, AZ, the Gateway to the Grand Canyon! Trappers Rendezvous is your perfect spot to relax during your trip, just about a mile from the bustling center of this Route 66 town with a view of the mountains. Sit in your porch chairs with a drink in hand to watch the sunset, or let the kids get their travel wiggles out running around outside in the warm months!

Breakfast is offered as an optional addition to your stay, with options from a To-Go bag packed to start your early morning adventures, to a light breakfast basket with homemade muffins and other delights to be enjoyed in your room, outdoor pavilion or guest den! Breakfast must be booked with the innkeeper at least 24 hours prior to your stay.

Each room offers a private porch entrance, and convenient parking just a few steps from your door. All rooms have their own private en suite bathroom with tub/shower, with cozy bathrobes, extra towels, and a hairdryer provided, along with boutique body care products. Relax in the unique comfy seating space of your room, or put your feet up in bed and watch a movie on your flat-screen satellite TV. Our two suite rooms offer a second TV in the second room as well.

All rooms have their own mini fridge, coffee maker, and microwave, and our reception area is stocked with snacks and beverages that you are welcome to grab when you check in, or come in to visit guest den during your stay. All guests are welcome to use the propane grill under the central communal pavilion area. Trappers also offers one Family Suite that adds a kitchenette complete with full size refrigerator, dishes, sink, toaster, electric skillet, crock pot, microwave steamer, and private back porch to enjoy your meal as a family.

Our fire pit is available for guests to use on their own, when fire restrictions are not in place. Trappers provides kindling and logs, fire starter and lighters, and even marshmallow sticks!

The Grand Canyon South Rim is just about an hour drive through beautiful high desert. Drive yourself, or book a train ride on the Grand Canyon Railway!

Closer to home, take advantage of the miles and miles of hiking trails and lakes surrounding us in Kaibab National Forest, hit the links at Elephant Rocks Golf Course, have a wildlife adventure at Bearizona, or enjoy exciting day-trips to Flagstaff, Sedona, Prescott, or historic Jerome.
